spans.s:
एरका A kind of grass (said to
have turned to clubs when plucked
by Kṛṣṇa and his family; cf. Mb.
मौसलपर्वन्).
--कं A woollen carpet.

एरंडः The castor-oil plant; (a
small tree with a scanty number of
leaves); and hence the proverb:
निरस्तपादपे देशे एरंडोपि द्रुमायते.
--डा Long
pepper.
--Comp.
--पत्रिका, --फला the
plant Croton Polyandrum (दंतीवृक्ष).
